audit.whatIsWrong: Two real interactions were absent: Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, and Arctic Assault only stops on a champion.
audit.why: Karma's whole kit leans on the Inner Flame slow and on body-blocking engage. Neither works here until Frost Armor is broken, and minions do not stop her charge.
audit.corrected: Slow immunity stated in phases[1].why; the through-minions charge and its 18s rank-1 cooldown stated in breakdown.cooldowns, alongside Permafrost needing max Frost stacks to stun.

audit.why: Arctic Assault 18s at rank 1 is the step-up window; Permafrost's 1.5s cooldown is irrelevant if you deny Frost stacks.

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: Frost Armor grants slow immunity — your Q chips but never kites her while she builds Frost stacks.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: Your poke is real but Frost Armor and base tankiness deny a kill, and Permafrost stuns at max stacks — even.

edits.before: Spam the RQ slow-field on his farming spots and keep your shield for Arctic Assault — the lane is a toll booth and you own it.
edits.after: Winter's Wrath is down every 7s at rank 3 and a Permafrost stun follows, so one over-stepped Q rotation and she out-trades you.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Mantra-W heals you and extends Focused Resolve through her engage — the one stage you genuinely beat her.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: Her tank item plus Glacial Prison at 120s locks you before your root — armor eats the chip.

edits.before: You drift toward utility now — peel, shield, and speed your carries while the RQ poke softens objectives.
edits.after: She becomes a near-unkillable engage tank; your chip bounces, so play peel, shields and speed instead.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Sejuani carry threat 5/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5/10, Sejuani carry threat 6/10.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Sejuani carry threat 5/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5/10, Sejuani carry threat 6/10.

edits.before: - Sejuani Arctic Assault: matchup-defining — Her dash knockup — she has no kill threat while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E shield is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Sejuani Arctic Assault: 18s at rank 1, and it charges through minions and only stops on a champion — you cannot body-block it. Step up on its downtime. - Permafrost is 1.5s but needs max Frost stacks; deny the stacks and the stun never fires.

notes: Frost Armor's slow immunity is the interaction the page was missing — Inner Flame's slow does nothing to her until it is broken. Level chart now matches the packet chart and the already-audited mirror on all seven rows. Source conflict on win rate: packet says 48% over 25 games, the mirror recorded 53.31% over 257; I rated the lane EVEN rather than pick one.
